opening.argument: The video presents a paid, tiered path to Forsage earnings while claiming participation can occur without recruiting: the stated strategy is to “buy all the levels” or at least through Level eight. The speaker then makes the condition explicit: “for you to take advantage of it, you need to buy more levels.” The supplied interface shows ETH-denominated level options and a visible BUY control, while the payment mechanism is described as “based on spillover” from people above and from participants who are recruiting. The speaker therefore links access to higher-level purchases and others’ recruitment, while cautioning viewers not to expect the same results as someone who recruits and to be patient. That is a recruitment-dependent commission structure presented through successive paid levels, not an independent earnings opportunity.
